import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print("No")
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    strings = data[1:n+1]
    
    is_palindrome = lambda s: s == s[::-1]
    
    result = any(is_palindrome(s) for s in strings)
    
    print("Yes" if result else "No")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
